title: Estimate Stiffness
tagline: The four flex numbers of any EI curve -- yours, a target, a competitor's -- between two contact points.

slides.title: What it does
slides.problem: EI and Cross Section gives flex numbers for a modelled layup. Estimate Stiffness gives the same four numbers for any EI curve, so a measured or target curve can be compared on the same scale.
useWhen: Rate a target or measured EI curve
Compare two EI curves by the numbers
slides.caption: The test behind the numbers: FCP-ACP simply supported, load at the mount.

slides.title: The dialog
params: The EI curve: an edge in the XZ plane, world Z in mm = EI in N m^2 (EI and Cross Section's <name>_EI, a measured or a target curve).
Read-only: prismatic lb/in and mm/30 kg; estimated (variable EI) lb/in and mm/30 kg.

items.head: Dialog only
items.body: Numbers are computed when you press Recalculate and do not follow later geometry changes.

items.head: FCP before ACP
items.body: If FCP is not before ACP in X nothing is computed, silently.

items.head: Short curves
items.body: An EI curve shorter than FCP-ACP is extended to reach them.
